title: Signal Cartographer
description: A tactical canvas survival game about mapping a hostile signal field before interference erases your route.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Code, launcher updates, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

keyboard: WASD or Arrow keys to move
pointer: Drag or press on the chart to steer toward a point
touch: Use the direction pad and beacon button

repositoryNote: This is the first original playable entry in 99 AI Games.
